title: Component index
description: A generated join of a snapshot's component inventory against the component docs written for them. Resolved layer: disposable, regenerated rather than edited, and deliberately not part of the snapshot contract. See references/component-index.md.

generatedAt.description: The only field that changes between two runs over the same inputs.

sources.description: What this index was built from. An index that cannot name its sources cannot be checked, so all three are required and `map` is explicitly null rather than absent when none was used.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version of the snapshot read. Null only when components.json carried none.

componentFiles.description: Distinct `source` values found in the inventory, sorted. The Figma files this index covers.

fileCount.description: Candidate pages considered: top-level .md files, less README.md and anything in the map's notComponentDocs.

map.description: Path to the classification map, or null when none was found. Null means every Figma file was treated as documentable components, so a coverage figure may be diluted by assets.

counts.description: Totals across every entry, plus `documentable`. `documented + missing + ambiguous + notApplicable` always equals `components`.

bySource.description: The same tally per Figma file. This is the figure to quote: one file holds icons and another holds components, so a single library-wide percentage mixes two populations.

components.description: Every component in the snapshot, sorted by id. Identity fields are restated from components.json rather than referenced, because this file is meant to be read on its own; it is a derived view, so the duplication is disposable.

unmatchedDocs.description: Pages no component claimed. Either the component was renamed in Figma, or the page is not a component doc and belongs in the map's notComponentDocs list.

documentable.description: Entries not excluded as assets. The denominator for any coverage figure.

id.description: Verbatim from components.json. The join key, unchanged, so this index can never introduce an identity of its own.

coverage.description: One block per surface. Only `docs` exists at 1.0.0; `web` and `app` are the intended additions and would sit alongside it with the same shape.

state.description: `ambiguous` is never silently resolved: two things that could match means a person decides, via the map's aliases. `not-applicable` is an asset-source entry, excluded from the denominator.

path.description: The page, relative to the Code folder. Null unless state is `documented`.

matchedBy.description: Which rule fired. Recorded because a wrong match and a real doc are indistinguishable once both read as `documented`.

candidates.description: The pages in contention when state is `ambiguous`. Empty otherwise.

note.description: Present only when something needs saying: an alias pointing at a missing file, or which components share a name.
